content: Papuru 'Epetsutsie kemɨtiuyeikakai
Hikɨ 'Apuruxi Kurinitutsie 'akuxi 'uyeikakaku, Papuru hɨri 'utɨa 'uyeyaka 'Epetsutsie kaneta'ani. Hipame teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mana kaniwaretaxeiya.
Mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'iwawiya: —¿Xeme 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata xete'utanaki'eri yuri xemɨte'uta'eritsie? Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenita'eiya: —Hawaikɨ matsi 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata hepaɨtsita tepɨka'enanawawe.
Hikɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'iwawiya: —¿Titatsie xetewiyatɨ xete'uka'ɨyarie? Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenita'eiya: —Wani kemɨtiuka'ɨyakai xeikɨa teniuka'ɨyarieni tame.

Papuru mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Wani kaniwaruka'ɨyakaitɨni metehayewakaku ke'axamemɨteyuriekai, mɨpaɨ tiwakuxaxatɨwatɨ teɨteri yuri memɨteta'erienikɨ kemɨ'ane 'utɨmana 'umamiekaitsie. Mɨkɨ Ketsutsi kanixatakaitɨni Kɨritsitu.
Me'u'enanaka mekaniuka'ɨyarieni Ti'aitame Ketsutsi hetsiemieme.
Papuru waheima kaniutimeni, 'ana 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata mehexeiyatɨ mekanakɨne, hipame niukitekɨ me'utiniutɨ mekanakɨne meta Kakaɨyari niukieya mekanikuxatakaitɨni.
Yunaitɨ teɨteri tamamata heimana huta mepɨyupaɨmekai.
Hikɨ Papuru huriyutsixi watukita kani'axekaitɨni tikuxatatɨ kamatɨ haika metseri puyuri. Niuki kanikuxatakaitɨni, yuri memɨteta'erienikɨ, Kakaɨyari ti'aitametɨkaku tikuxatatɨ.

Hipatɨ mekanitsetse'ikaitɨni, yuri mepɨkate'uta'eri, 'axame'utiyuatɨ mɨkɨ huye hepaɨtsita yumɨireme wahɨxie. Papuru waruku'eirieka teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete kaniwaranuyewitɨni. Tukarikɨ Tiranu mɨti'ɨkitakaitsie niuki kanikuxatakaitɨni.
Mɨpaɨ huta wiyari katiniyurienekaitɨni, yunaitɨ 'Atsiyatsie memɨtamakai huriyutsixi meta kɨriyekutsixi Ti'aitame niukieya mekaniu'enieni.
Hikɨ Kakaɨyari 'inɨari tɨrɨkawime katiniyurienekaitɨni Papuru yatiyurienekaku.
Tekwikwikate watuwaxate meta wapetserate mepɨwarehuririwakai Papuru mimayuanikɨ, mɨkɨkɨ yukwiniyakɨ 'aixɨameteheu'erietɨ mepakɨkakai, meta kakaɨyarixi 'axamemɨ'anene wahetsie mepayekɨkakai.

Hipatɨ ku'uwamete huriyutsixi kakaɨyarixi memɨwaranuyenɨ'awakai, mɨkɨ Ti'aitame Ketsutsi mekanitixatatɨkɨne, kakaɨyarixi 'axamemɨ'anene memɨwanɨkai teɨteri wahepaɨtsita, mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: «Ne nepɨxe'aitɨa Ketsutsi hetsiemieme Papuru mikuxata hetsɨa, nepɨxewawirie xemayekɨnekɨ».
'Ikɨ huriyu 'Itsikewa mɨtitewakai mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame, mɨkɨ 'atahutame yuniwema kaniwarexeiyakaitɨni mɨpaɨ meteyuriekame.
Hikɨ 'iyari 'axamɨ'ane mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya, Ketsutsi nepɨmate: «Meta Papuru nepetima, peru xeme, ¿kemɨ'ane xepɨyɨa?»
Mɨkɨ tewi 'iyari 'axamɨ'ane miwiyakai waheima kaniutiweni, kaniwara'iwa yunaime tɨrɨkaɨyetɨ. Mɨkɨtsɨ memamawetɨ meheuxitekietɨkaitɨ mekaniyuta'una kiita.
Kepauka memɨte'utamari kemɨtiuyɨ yunaitɨ huriyutsixi meta kɨriyekutsixi 'Epetsutsie memɨtamakai. Waɨkawa yunaitɨ mekanimamakaitɨni. Kemɨ'ane Ti'aitame Ketsutsi mɨhɨkɨ 'aixɨa tikuxaxatsiwatɨ kanayani.
Yumɨiretɨ yuri memɨte'uta'eri mekaniu'axɨani meyuhekɨatatɨ 'axakememɨteyuriekai.

Yumɨiretɨ mɨkɨ memɨteyukewaiyakai, yuxapate me'ukuxeɨrieka yunaime wahɨxie mekanititaiya. Hikɨ mekaniti'inɨata 'axeikɨa kepaɨmemetsie naitɨ mɨ'akai xapayari, huta tewiyari heimana tamamata miriyari pɨrata tuminiyari kanayani.
Mɨpaɨ tiuyɨku, Ti'aitame niukieya tɨrɨkaɨyemekɨ kaniutimɨire, kaniutɨrɨkare.
Hikɨ mɨya tiuyɨku, Papuru yu'iyaritsie kaniyuwaɨriya Matseruniyatsie meta 'Akaiyatsie 'uyeyame Kerutsaremetsie meta'anikɨ, mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: «Mana neheta'ame, peuyewetse Xumatsie nemeumiekɨ».
Hikɨ yuhutame yuparewiwamete Timuteu meta 'Eratsitu Matseruniyatsie kaniwarenɨ'ani, mexi'akuxi 'Atsiyatsie yapaɨmexɨa tukari 'ukatei.
'Epetsutari kememɨteyuxamuriekai
Hikɨ 'ana waɨkawamekɨ mepɨyumuinakai teɨteri mɨkɨ huye hepaɨtsita.
Xewitɨ Remetɨriyu mɨtitewakai pɨrata wewiwame mɨhɨkɨtɨkai, pɨrata kakaɨyarixiyari pɨwawewiekai Riyana hepaɨ tiyuxexeiyame. Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ tiyurienetɨ waɨkawa 'iwarika kaniwapitɨakaitɨni tewewiwamete.
Hikɨ warukuxeɨrieka mɨkɨ, wahepaɨ te'uximayatamete wahamame, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Neuxei, xeme xekatenimaika tame temɨte'iwa 'ikɨ ta'uximayatsikakɨ.

Mɨpaɨ xepɨtexeiya, mɨpaɨ xepɨte'enana, Papuru yuri kemɨtiwa'eritɨa kemɨtiwarukunuitɨa yumɨireme teɨteri, 'ena 'Epetsutsie xeikɨa pɨkatixaɨ, matsi naitsarie 'Atsiyatsie. Mɨpaɨ katinikuxatani, mɨkɨ mamakɨ memɨwewiyatɨka kakaɨyarixi mepɨkahɨkɨ 'utaitɨ.

Mɨkɨ meta, tita temɨtehexeiya tame pɨkweriwa'ane kapa yakɨ'ayanikɨ. Matsi meta, 'ikɨ kakaɨyari mɨtɨrɨkaɨye Riyana tukieya, tixaɨ katihɨkɨtɨme teɨteri me'erietɨ. Yunaitɨ 'atsiyatari, naitsarie kwiepa memɨtamata, kemɨ'ane memayexeiya, 'ikɨ tɨrɨkariyaya pɨka'unariexime.
Hikɨ me'u'enanaka mepuyeha'a. Mekaniutihiwakaitɨni mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: —Kanitɨrɨkaɨyeni 'epetsutari takakaɨyari Riyana.
Naitsarie kiekaritsie mepuyuxamurietɨwekai. 'Axeikɨa mepekɨ me'unautsaxɨaximetɨ xeɨripa, mewarutiwiyaka Kayu meta 'Aritsitariku matseruniyatari Papuru teɨtametemama memɨhɨkɨtɨkai.
Papuru kanihamɨkɨkaitɨni yumɨiretɨ teɨteri memayuxeɨrie wahɨxie, peru teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mepɨka'ipitɨa.
Hipatɨ 'Atsiya kwieyaritsie kiekatari 'itsɨkate, hamikumama memɨhɨkɨtɨkai, xapa mekaneinɨ'airieni waɨkamekɨ me'iwawirietɨ xeɨripa mɨkamiekɨ.
Hikɨ hipatɨ yɨkɨ mete'uhiwatɨ hipatɨta yɨkɨ pɨta mekateniuhiwakaitɨni. Mana xeikɨa mekaniyukuxeɨrieni yunaitɨ, yumɨiretɨ 'atsimepɨkatemaikai titayari muwa memɨte'u'axɨakai.
'Amemu'uwakai watsata mekanenuyexeiya 'Arekanituru, huriyutsixi me'itakeku wahɨxie. 'Arekanituru yumamakɨ waru'inɨaritɨaka kaniniumɨkɨkaitɨni yuhetsiemieme memɨyukuxeɨri wahɨxie.
Meheitimaika Huriyu mɨhɨkɨtɨkaikɨ, karima mekaniutihiwakaitɨni 'axeikɨa yunaitɨ huta hurayari mepuyuri mɨpaɨ mete'uhiwatɨ: —Kanitɨrɨkaɨyeni 'epetsutari takakaɨyari Riyana.

Hikɨ kiekaritsie ti'aitame ti'utɨwame waku'imaiyatɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe memuyuxeɨriekai: —Neuxei 'epetsutari, ¿hakewatsɨ tewi 'atsimɨkatimate kename 'Epetsu kiekatari Riyana mɨtɨrɨkaɨye tukita temɨte'aita, Kupiteritsɨa makane tete kakaɨyariyari hɨwemetemama?
Hikɨ, xɨka mɨpaɨ 'aneni, xɨka kayuxamurieka 'ikɨ niuki, kaneuyeweka kayuwatɨ xemɨtamarekɨ 'axaxemɨkateyu'eniwanikɨ.
Xekaniwa'atɨani 'ikɨ teɨteri, tsepa 'axamemɨkate'uyuri tuki hepaɨtsita, tsepa 'axamemɨkatekuxata xekakaɨyari hepaɨtsita.

'Ayumieme Remetɨriyu, tewewiwamete hamatɨana memu'uwa xɨka tixaɨ metehexeiya xeime hepaɨtsita, tukari puxuawe kepauka 'itsɨkate 'amemɨtiteni, mɨkɨ kwiepa memɨhɨritɨarie 'amekaniu'uwani. Mana yuxanetsika mekehe'atɨani.
Xɨkatsɨ matsi 'akuxi xetekuwauni, 'aixɨa pɨyɨni kepauka kiekatari memɨyuxeɨrie, 'inɨari niukiyari kemaine.
Hikɨmɨtsɨari tepɨkweriwa'aka kapa tahetsie rahɨiyanikɨ 'axatemɨtewakɨhɨawekɨ hikɨ, tsepa mɨkareuyewekai. Tame tepɨkayɨwawe yɨkɨ temaitɨkani tahetsiemieme 'ikɨ xamurikakɨ.
Mɨpaɨ 'utayɨka memayuxeɨrietsie kaniwaranuyenɨ'ani memɨyehukɨ.
